name: autoform
description: Set up Lean repositories, build and formalize source-grounded Markdown roadmaps, and support review.

interface.longDescription: AutoForm separates repository setup, source-grounded roadmap construction, Markdown-native Lean formalization, and review; the Obsidian-compatible vault remains the shared source of truth and publishes through GitHub Pages.
defaultPrompt: Set up this Lean repository with an Autoform vault, verification CI, and GitHub Pages without planning the mathematics.
Build and validate a source-grounded Autoform roadmap, using a persistent Goal when available.
Formalize the ready Markdown roadmap frontier in Lean and record only verified progress.
